name: goal-owner
title: Goal owner (主理人) persistence, continuation owner routing, and fail-closed owner removal
description: Persist a goal owner {agentId, agentName} (default empty; stamped as the proposer when a set proposal is accepted), let the user set/change it via a goal-card dropdown, route goal continuation to the owner with priority over default_last_agent, keep empty-owner behavior unchanged, and auto-pause the goal with a pending resume proposal (fail-closed, never silently falling back) when the owner is removed from the roster.
